_comment: Rebuild media/clip.wav: download the episode MP3 (URL in README) to source/ep434-artemis-iii-training.mp3, then: showtime audio mix source/clip.json -o work/clip.raw.wav; showtime footage denoise work/clip.raw.wav -o work/clip.clean.wav --strength 0.5; showtime audio master work/clip.clean.wav -o media/clip.wav --target podcast --preset voice
